annotations.title: Odds ratio, relative risk and NNT

description: Effect sizes for a 2x2 table [[a, b], [c, d]] whose rows are two groups and whose columns are outcome yes and no: the odds ratio (Woolf interval, and the conditional exact interval), the relative risk (Katz interval), the risk difference (Newcombe interval) and the number needed to treat, at the chosen confidence level, plus Fisher's exact p. A zero cell applies the Haldane-Anscombe correction to the Woolf and Katz estimates, and the result says so.

confidence_level.description: Confidence level for intervals, between 0.5 and 0.9999. Default 0.95.
